name: Optimist
bio: Always looks on the bright side. Enjoys social get-togethers, sunny outdoor afternoons, and crisp, thirst-quenching citrus beverages.
whyPerfect: Quench your thirst and brighten your day with the crisp, natural citrus burst of Squirt Original Grapefruit Soda. Bursting with real grapefruit flavor, it's the ultimate refreshing pick-me-up and perfect for mixing an authentic Paloma.
description: Ice-cold 12 oz can of Squirt Original Grapefruit Soda with real citrus juice, light fizzy carbonation, and caffeine-free daytime refreshment.
imagePrompt: Portrait of a smiling, cheerful young woman in her 20s holding an ice-cold can of Squirt grapefruit soda at a sunny patio gathering, bright natural lighting.

details.bio: Joy is energetic, loves hosting friends for taco nights, and seeks bright, natural flavors. She loves Squirt both on its own over ice and mixed with tequila for fresh Palomas.

name: Pessimist
bio: Highly skeptical of overly sweet soda and synthetic diet claims. Expects artificial aftertastes and demands genuine, tart citrus quality.
whyPerfect: No cloying sweetness or watered-down fizz. Squirt Zero Sugar delivers the authentic, tart grapefruit bite you love with zero sugar, zero calories, and zero compromises.
description: Squirt Zero Sugar 12-pack (12 oz cans) crafted with real grapefruit concentrate for an uncompromisingly crisp, tart citrus refreshment.
imagePrompt: Portrait of a discerning man in his 50s inspecting a zero-sugar soda can, clean modern kitchen, crisp natural lighting.

details.bio: Arthur monitors his sugar intake closely and despises artificial sweetener taste. He chose Squirt Zero Sugar because its genuine grapefruit bite cuts through thirst without tasting synthetic.

name: Regular
bio: Everyday casual consumer who drinks what is convenient and familiar. Balances price, taste, and accessibility across grocery stores, gas stations, and drive-thrus.
whyPerfect: The reliable, thirst-quenching citrus refresher that is easy to grab for the whole family during weekend cookouts, road trips, and daily lunches.
description: Squirt Original Grapefruit Soda 12-pack cans and 20 oz grab-and-go bottles with dependable tart citrus fizz.
imagePrompt: Portrait of a friendly casual 35-year-old consumer in comfortable weekend casual attire enjoying a cold Squirt soda, relaxed setting.

details.bio: Sam looks for convenience and reliable family-pleasing taste. He grabs 12-packs on supermarket sale and 20 oz cold bottles on road trips.
